notes: NEW CONFIGURE TAB — phase 1 of 6. Two columns: your panel on the left, its configuration on the right. The left column is not a picture of the panel, it IS the panel — drawn by the panel's own renderer, at the portal's real width…
It repaints when anything changes, so editing on the right will move the panel on the left rather than describing what would happen to it.

The panel column stays put while the right column scrolls. The panel runs past the bottom of the window, and a configuration surface where the thing being configured scrolls out of view is one you are editing blind.

Weather and Shortcuts data now reach a preview too. Without it the live panel was missing exactly one card against the real one — found by counting cards in both, not by looking: one absent card in a ten-card column does not announce…

Phase 1 ships the shell and the panel only. Selection, the per-Rune toggle and the configuration panes follow in the next phases, and the existing tabs stay exactly where they are until their controls have somewhere to move to.
